name: Fused Step 1 tensor preparation
hypothesis: Keep v001 operations unchanged except write scaled and normalized Step 1 pixels directly into the final NCHW tensor. This tests whether avoiding the intermediate FP32 RGB image and transpose copy reduces preprocessing latency.
changes: Write each resized RGB channel directly into its final NCHW plane while applying the equivalent scale and mean/std normalization.

quality_policy.gate: same cohort, no failures, and no MAE, RMSE, or per-photo absolute-error regression; microbatch smoke results are not a quality conclusion
